meta.title: A brief history of AI coding
meta.subtitle: Since November 2025
meta.tldr: No one is writing code anymore, and we are still figuring out what that means.

glossary.ralph-loop: Run the same prompt against an agent in a loop until the task is done. Brute force, sometimes effective.
glossary.orchestration: One agent splits the work, hands it to others and checks what comes back.
glossary.cognitive-debt: Code in your product that nobody on the team understands, because nobody wrote it.
glossary.skills: Packaged, shareable instructions an agent loads for a kind of task.
glossary.review-surface: Whatever you use to judge an agent's work: a diff, a spec, a rendered page, a test report.
glossary.software-factory: A pipeline where agents build software with little or no human in the loop.
glossary.dark-factory: A software factory that runs with the lights off: no humans at all.
glossary.asd-ste100: Simplified Technical English: short sentences and a fixed vocabulary, written for manuals.

events.title: Good enough for 95%
events.summary: The community agrees that models are good enough to handle 95% of coding tasks.

events.title: Ralph loops
events.summary: Ralph loops get popular. Early efforts on loops and orchestration.

events.title: Everyone is knackered
events.summary: Too much strategic decision-making. Fears around cognitive debt begin.

events.title: The skills explosion
events.summary: The community converges on easy-to-share processes. Superpowers was already ahead of the game here.

events.title: No code in months
events.summary: Most state-of-the-art developers haven't written a line of code in months.

events.title: The unreasonable effectiveness of HTML
events.summary: More interest in richer review surfaces.

events.title: Loop Engineering
events.summary: "Loop Engineering" wins vaguepost of the year, a sign of more hype around process.

events.title: Here is my software factory
events.summary: Every talk at every conference becomes "here is my software factory".

events.title: Manager threads
events.summary: Grok Bot gets popular. More interest in long-running "manager" threads that keep context and delegate work.

events.title: Where are the speed gains?
events.summary: The promised speed gains haven't materialised. The dark factory still feels a long way off.
